# Deye Solar Monitor (โซลาร์มอนิเตอร์)

> Free, self-hosted real-time monitor for Deye solar inverters, in Thai. It reads the official Deye Cloud Open API and shows PV production, home load, battery and grid import/export, with a production forecast that learns from the user's own roof, measured battery health, savings, and Discord/Telegram alerts. Runs on the Cloudflare Workers + D1 free tier and installs on a phone as a PWA.

Key facts:
- Works with any Deye system that reports to Deye Cloud: on-grid, hybrid and off-grid.
- Needs a Deye developer account (developer.deyecloud.com) for an App ID and App Secret.
- Cost: no monthly fee. Polls every 5 minutes (288 requests/day), far below the 100,000/day free limit.
- Deye credentials are server-side secrets only; users sign in with a PIN; the dashboard is noindex.
- Install: "Deploy to Cloudflare" button, or `npm run setup`.
- Stack: Vite, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, D1, Cron, vite-plugin-pwa, Vitest.
- App interface language: Thai.
